messages:
maya: heads-up — i'm planning a small tf module refactor this week: moving provider blocks out of modules/billing into the root, adding provider pins in the new lockfile, and switching the k8s secret path for billing service to `infra/billing/credentials` (previously `services/billing/creds`). quick sanity check before i open the PR?
raj: oof provider hoist + state move can be fiddly. are you planning to `terraform state mv` any resources or just provider config hoist?
maya: just hoisting provider config and updating module interfaces to accept provider aliases. no resource moves expected. i will regen the lockfile and include compatibility notes. plan looks shallow in staging so far.
sam: +1 on sharing the plan output. also include the `required_providers` and `terraform` blocks you plan to change to make rollbacks easier.
maya: paste of the minimal change i'm going to push:
```hcl
# root/versions.tf
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5"
  required_providers {
    google = { source = "hashicorp/google" }
    kubernetes = { source = "hashicorp/kubernetes" }
  }
}

# modules/billing/main.tf -> remove provider blocks and add provider arguments
module "billing" {
  source = "../modules/billing"
  providers = { google = google }
}
```
maya: i'll run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64` and commit the generated .terraform.lock.hcl from the root only.
raj: good. ensure you run a full `terraform init -upgrade` in staging and validate provider checksum changes. also check that any consumers relying on module-level implicit provider inheritance are updated.
tanya: on the k8s secret rename — are you planning a migration job? existing pods read `k8s://services/billing/creds`.
maya: yes, i have a short k8s job that copies the secret to the new namespace+name. will gate it behind a canary deploy. snippet:
```bash
kubectl get secret services-billing-creds -n services -o yaml | \
  sed 's/name: services-billing-creds/name: infra-billing-credentials/' | \
  kubectl apply -n infra -f -
```
chris: for Dedicated customers we should avoid any drift during the window — suggest adding a read fallback in the app: try new secret path then old one for a week.
maya: good call, i'll add a fallback in the configmap and roll canary for 2 days before deleting the old secret.
raj: one more: lockfile churn can cause CI diffs if people run `init -upgrade` locally. add a CI check that the committed .terraform.lock.hcl matches `terraform providers lock` output or run `terraform init -backend=false` in CI and compare.
infra-bot: quick check results: staging init OK, providers compatible. (scan id: infra-7429) :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks infra-bot. i'll open the PR shortly, include a checklist: regen lockfile, update module docs, add canary job, config fallback, and smoke plan output. pinging @sam @raj for reviews.
sam: i'll review the lockfile + doc changes tomorrow morning.
raj: will do a security review on the secret copy job. watch for IAM bindings when copying google secrets.
maya: appreciated. i'll post the PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
